selection_analysis.selection_reason: The residual surface is re-ranked globally from the corrected 164-case state. prim.tool.lifecycle has the highest single-step unlock leverage at 122 and already contains a compact three-case, one-receipt result/effect bounded-claims cluster. The selected cases share one ToolExecution -> ToolResult -> EffectObservation evidence chain and one bounded-evidence predicate family. The verifier typed-findings cluster is denser at seven cases on one report fixture but has lower leverage and would open a broader VerificationReport-native execution surface. Claim, model, provider, and source candidates have lower leverage or weaker scenario density. TOOL-011 is deliberately excluded even though it shares tool-effect.json because its JSON Pointer argument-path semantics are not part of the result/effect bounded-claims cluster.
